dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and continuous reduction in planar width from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A minor asymmetrical bulge is visible on the left lateral margin relative to the right margin at the mid-section transition.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane, indicating a near-mature pigment phase.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple fine, low-contrast linear markings (rake marks) on the central dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear abrasions or scratches are visible on the mid-dorsal area.
